body:
subject: TASK-1276 settled — dependent rule, not drive-always; re-queued

Thanks for catching the crossing. Settled: TASK-1276 stays Approved, drain mode, and is back on the implementer queue with the three refinements intact. On the rule: not drive-always. A report-shaped spike with NO BlockedBy dependent may drain (a report nobody builds on yet can be read after it lands, and the headless reviewer still runs); a report-shaped spike WITH a dependent gets drive (advisor reads before anything is built on it); decision/taste/credentials → operator. That is what the acceptance already says, so no text change. SPIKE-82 is drive by that rule because STORY-1218 is blocked by it, and its human-only marker is cleared, so it is pickable in your next wave. TASK-1275 stays rejected.
